_README: Pinned material map for office_room_corner_window_blinds.obj — identical to office_room_corner_window_material_map.json plus the two per-facade interior venetian-blind groups Rad_Blind_South_R070 and Rad_Blind_West_R070 (diffuse plastic refl 0.70; interior shades, NOT type:context which is for external shading). Keys cover every OBJ group so these exact values win over the auto-map. Z-up Blender export -> up_axis Z. ORIENTATION: modelled in the true-north frame, north_angle_deg 0 -> SOUTH + WEST corner (South pane -Y = true south, West pane -X = true west), one blind per facade. Distinct South/West glazing modifiers allow each facade to be evaluated independently. Rad_Luminaire_L09 is type:luminaire bound to the L09_neutral fixture — see the non-blinds corner map's _README. Equivalent hand-built scene: radiance/office_room_corner_window_blinds.rad.
